For inpatient facility claims, POA indicators are required for primary and secondary diagnoses. If a secondary diagnosis is an HCAC, reimbursement may be reduced or denied.

reimbursement_policies.policy_title: RM-018 Serious Adverse Events (Never Events & Hospital Acquired Conditions)
reimbursement_policies.evidence: Not specifically addressed by this policy. The policy denies reimbursement for serious adverse events, including never events and hospital acquired conditions, on inpatient and outpatient claims, and excludes HAC-related charges and days from MS-DRG payment calculations when applicable.

This is a general inpatient DRG payment-reduction rule for selected health care-acquired conditions. When an HCAC is not present on admission, the diagnosis is removed from the DRG calculation and the higher CC/MCC DRG payment is not paid; outlier days or covered charges related to the HCAC may also be denied after review.

reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Payment Methodology for Inpatient Hospital Services
reimbursement_policies.evidence: Florida Medicaid uses APR-DRGs for inpatient hospital claims and pays an additional outlier amount when estimated hospital losses exceed the AHCA-set threshold. The rule is claim-level, cost-driven, and applies within the DRG payment methodology.

recommended_action.description:
Recommendation 1: For CA cesarean-delivery inpatient facility claims, require POA-based adjudication on the same inpatient claim / UB-04 claim whenever Y65.51, Y65.52, or Y65.53 is reported with a POA indicator on the inpatient facility claim. Apply to CA. Exempt: condition existed prior to treatment, secondary facility treated the HAC, Critical Access Hospitals, Medicare-exempt facilities. Peer: Paramount Healthcare and Parkland Community Health Plan also apply inpatient PPC/HAC guardrails to Y65.51, Y65.52, and Y65.53; Paramount ties the event to modifiers PC, PB, or PA during the same hospitalization..

IA — Add a same inpatient claim manual outlier review for CA cesarean-delivery stays before separate DRG/APR-DRG consideration when estimated hospital loss is above threshold or discharge status 02, 05, 65, 66, 82, 85, 93, or 94 is present. (CA) Elevance internal and State FFS both anchor inpatient adjudication to the same inpatient claim in DRG workflows, supporting a claim-level outlier trigger..
IA — Require daily NICU acuity evaluation for revenue codes 0200, 0201, 0202, 0203, 0206, 0208, 012X, 013X, 015X, and 0732 throughout the inpatient stay before paying higher-acuity inpatient days on cesarean-delivery outliers. (CA)
